properties.name: app.auth.bootstrap.username
properties.description: Bootstrap admin username used for credential administration.

properties.name: app.auth.bootstrap.password
properties.description: Bootstrap admin password used for credential administration.

properties.name: app.auth.bootstrap.roles
properties.description: Comma-separated roles for bootstrap admin account.

properties.name: app.auth.bootstrap.aliases
properties.description: Comma-separated alias usernames that authenticate as master/bootstrap admin.

properties.name: app.auth.password.min-length
properties.description: Minimum accepted password length for employee credentials.

properties.name: app.auth.password.max-length
properties.description: Maximum accepted password length for employee credentials.

properties.name: app.auth.lockout.max-failed-attempts
properties.description: Number of failed attempts before temporary lockout.

properties.name: app.auth.lockout.window-minutes
properties.description: Time window in minutes used to count failed attempts.

properties.name: app.auth.lockout.duration-minutes
properties.description: Temporary lockout duration in minutes after reaching the failed-attempt threshold.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated allowed origins for CORS (for example Angular dev server URLs).
